In 2020, FDA (Food and Drug Administration) approved triheptanoin (Dojolvi), a 7 carbon chain triglyceride, in the US, as
a source of calories in children and adults with long-chain fatty acid oxidation disorders. FDA based its approval on a 4-month
double-blind randomized controlled study in which triheptanoin and trioctanoin (8-carbon demonstrated similar efﬁcacy) (Gil-
lingham et al., 2017).
